title: East Village Slopeside #7002 | KEY.co
description_expanded: Inside, every detail has been curated for comfort and style, from the plush sectional and gas fireplace to the chef’s kitchen outfitted with Miele appliances and a wine fridge. Floor-to-ceiling windows frame breathtaking vistas, while the private balcony invites peaceful mornings or après-ski evenings in Adirondack chairs. Thoughtful touches like spa-inspired bathrooms, a dedicated workspace, and elegant dining for eight make this 1,250-square-foot residence ideal for both relaxation and entertaining. Whether carving fresh powder or simply unwinding fireside, Slopeside 7002 delivers the ultimate Deer Valley experience. Perfectly situated in the prestigious Residences at Deer Valley Grand Hyatt, Slopeside 7002 is a luxurious mountain retreat that blends upscale design with unbeatable access to outdoor adventure. Just moments from the new Deer Valley East Village lift, this two-bedroom, two-bathroom condo offers effortless access to world-class skiing, while being only a short drive to Park City's vibrant Main Street and nearby Heber Valley. Panoramic views of the Jordanelle Reservoir and snowcapped peaks set the tone for a refined getaway that’s as scenic as it is serene.
